note: Four ordered sections, each decides on one subject: the schedule, the job timestamps, the nightly windows, the secondary repository. First match wins. 'windows: abstain' means the window evaluation is not performed: a schedule in local time or a timestamp without a zone is not converted by guesswork.

schedule_rules.rationale: A schedule time that is not written HH:MM (for instance an unquoted value that YAML reads as a number) is not interpreted.
Scheduled work is anchored to UTC. A schedule in local time moves with daylight saving and, once a year, names an hour that happens twice.

timestamp_rules.rationale: A job timestamp that is not a timestamp: the trace cannot be trusted for timing.
A timestamp without a zone does not say which instant it is. Windows are not evaluated on guessed instants.
A timestamp with an explicit offset is a known instant, so windows are still evaluated, but mixing local offsets with UTC in one trace is reported.

window_rules.rationale: A due window with no run inside its grace period was missed. The next run recovers the latest window once and says so; it does not pretend the night ran.

repo_rules.rationale: The secondary repository is read completely (lab/backup.py, inspect): the index to its last byte, every block the index lists against its address in the pack, every snapshot manifest, every listed file rebuilt to its recorded SHA-256. If any part cannot be read or does not verify - an index cut short, empty, not JSON or with a repeated key; a pack shorter than its index, or missing; a block that does not hash; a manifest that cannot be read or lists blocks the index does not have - the secondary is not readable: its content is not vouched for and its age is unknown. Unknown is reported with its location, it is not treated as fresh. Up to version 2026.09.30-2 the fact came from the created field of the newest manifest alone, so an index cut in half still counted as readable (finding T17).

A secondary repository without any snapshot - absent altogether, or read completely and holding no manifest - is not a second copy. After A-035 on purpose: a secondary whose index or snapshots folder cannot be read is unreadable, not merely empty.
The newest snapshot of the secondary repository is older than the newest of the primary by more than the allowed lag. The repository is read; the status a job printed is not evidence.
